paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: The plot illustrates BLEU scores as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for four methods (Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi). The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0, spanning roughly from about 2 to a little above 11. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, ranging from 25 to 33 with evenly spaced tick marks at 1-point intervals. The Consistency-CE series is drawn as a light purple dashed line with circular markers, increasing from about 25.8 at the leftmost AL point (around 2.5) to about 31.4 at the rightmost point (around 11–11.5), passing through approximately 28.0 (around AL 4), 29.9 (around AL 6–6.5), and 30.8–30.9 (around AL 9). The Inconsistency-CE series is a darker purple dashed line with square markers, rising from about 26.0 at the leftmost AL point (around 2.5) to about 31.4 at the rightmost point (around 11–11.5), with intermediate values near 28.1 (around AL 4), 29.9 (around AL 6–6.5), and 30.9 (around AL 9). The Inconsistency-CE-MP series is a blue dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 26.2 at the leftmost AL point (around 2–2.5) to about 31.7–31.8 at the rightmost point (around 11–11.5), with midpoints near 28.0 (around AL 4), 30.2 (around AL 6–6.5), and about 31.0 (around AL 9). The Consistency-Bi series is a red solid line with star markers, starting at about 28.9 at its leftmost plotted AL point (around 3), then moving upward through about 29.6 (around AL 5) and about 31.2 (around AL 7.5), reaching about 31.8 (around AL 10.5) and ending near 32.1 at the rightmost point (around 11–11.5).
